verdict.rationale: The docs describe a self-serve merchant path: add one line of server code to return HTTP 402 and require payment, receive funds at any address you control, use the hosted CDP Facilitator on a free tier, and get listed in the Bazaar automatically with "no registration form or separate API call." Independent operators running live x402 endpoints (httpay's 124 endpoints, the Apiosk gateway) and probes of the public npm SDK and the live keyless Bazaar index corroborate it. Missing for 10: the evidence does not document the step-by-step CDP account/API-key onboarding the facilitator needs (probes show it rejects requests without a key with HTTP 401).
